body.en: Early Brahmi is the script of Sri Lanka's oldest inscriptions, carved from about the 3rd century BCE. Most are short records cut below the drip-ledges of rock shelters, dedicating the caves to the Buddhist Sangha. The modern Sinhala script developed from it; the letter-evolution view in this app shows how individual letters changed over the centuries.

sources: S. Paranavitana, Inscriptions of Ceylon, Vol. I (1970)
confidence_note: The dating of the earliest inscriptions rests on palaeographic comparison and is debated.
